en: Color postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a densely built European city with red-tiled roofs. The tower has a steep shingled roof and prominent wooden gallery around the upper part, with two large clock faces showing Roman numerals. A path and greenery surround the tower, and several small figures stand at the overlook. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Uhrturm."
